ideas.pitch: Real-time anomaly detection and operational telemetry pipeline for IBM Z mainframe logs using hybrid isolation forests.
ideas.title: MainframeLog-Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the winning pattern of hard engineering and automated operations seen in iot-smart-home-ai-ops and danphobic, appealing directly to enterprise infrastructure judges.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven bias detection and mitigation pipeline tailored for credit scoring and risk models running on enterprise mainframe environments.
ideas.title: Z-FairLens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the algorithmic fairness methodology that won 3rd place at Place Hackathon, addressing high-stakes enterprise compliance.

ideas.pitch: Natural language to legacy database query and visualization engine translating unstructured requests into actionable enterprise dashboards.
ideas.title: Mainframe-Query-Bridge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of combining LLM agents with structured dashboard APIs, similar to the Tableau DataDev Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: A 3-turn metacognition and reasoning evaluation framework specifically measuring LLM accuracy on mainframe architecture and COBOL refactoring tasks.
ideas.title: Z-Metacog Benchmark
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the architectural rigor of the Google DeepMind x Kaggle AGI Hackathon grand prize winner.

ideas.pitch: Clinical-grade explainability engine using SHAP values to audit machine learning decisions made by legacy financial models migrated from IBM Z.
ideas.title: Cobol-Explain-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines robust explainability frameworks with predictive analytics, following the winning blueprint of the patient-readmission-prediction project.
